editionLabel: Wizards of the Coast English base game, 2012
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited another city goes first and receives the First Player marker.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The first player starts with 4 Gold. Going left around the table, each following player receives one more Gold than the previous player.
Turns begin with the First Player marker holder and proceed to the left.
